comment: PLAN 4.2d (ADR-251): the seas of seas.json (by name, every part) that pack ice closes to a fleet. A zone of one of them is in no way of a fleet and takes no order: the seas north of Siberia from the Kara Sea to the Chukchi Sea, the Arctic Ocean, and the Canadian Arctic from the Beaufort Sea to Baffin Bay. In 1938 only Soviet convoys behind icebreakers sailed the Northern Sea Route, in its weeks of summer, and no ship had sailed the North-West Passage since Amundsen's of 1903-1906. Open: the Barents and White Seas (Murmansk is free of ice), the Greenland and Norwegian Seas, the Davis Strait, Disko Bay and Hudson Bay by the Hudson Strait, the Bering Sea, the Baltic, and the Southern Ocean. The map has no seasons: what is closed is closed all the year.
